Bundled, unmodified runtime subset of zsh-users/zsh-syntax-highlighting 0.8.0:
https://github.com/zsh-users/zsh-syntax-highlighting/tree/db085e4661f6aafd24e5acb5b2e17e4dd5dddf3e

Includes the loader, main/brackets highlighters, version files and COPYING.md.
The upstream BSD terms and copyright notices apply to these files.
TMX loads this copy only in its own interactive Zsh panes when the user has
not already loaded zsh-syntax-highlighting. No install-time network is needed.
